w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (The Redactor, Inspiration, tick, The Paparazzo, Inspiration) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Sam. Gavel, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. The Focus Group is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Chorus Line is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: The Callback
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Callback: Say the goodbye — properly, out loud. It wears someone you buried. Every few rounds the face shifts and borrows their swing. Speak to it AS them — say the goodbye properly, out loud — and it loses coherence; the face cannot borrow a swing from someone who has been mourned. (Zoe lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Buffering

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🐗 RAID — 5 raiders (Judge Hoot, Loud-Eyes, The Loud Beast, Ugly-Eyes, Ad Break) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

w5Mentions.name: The Spoiler
w5Mentions.firstLine: 🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Leo. The Spoiler, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.
firstContext: The Bloodied watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

🕯️ Leo's funeral feast: 4,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Thornfield, Emberhold, The Bloodied. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Leo. The Spoiler, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.

w5Mentions.name: The Timeslot
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
firstContext: 💛 You hold Trail compass. Lost above the fog line, visibility down to your boots. You didn't panic — just held the compass flat, found north, and walked out like it was nothing. It was not nothing. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are still yours. The feast was the weap
Travel 1 tile to grove.
Something moves out there — The Timeslot.
👁️ Valeria freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
💬 Aurora whispers: "Someone's been leaving food out, and Wren won't admit a thing. Don't ask me how I know it wasn't one of us."

w5Mentions.name: The Nielsen
w5Mentions.firstLine: ◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
firstContext: 📺 SYSTEM: "EVERYONE. SIT. WATCH. The teeth and the weather can WAIT — nothing out there matters until this is done. ...Did I stutter? SIT."
◈ ABILITY — Dreadfield: The room feels you before you speak. Alien-terror starts at 2.
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ ABILITY — Oathbound: Your terror is pledged as a shield: your own people's horror grows half as fast.
◈ ABILITY — Shieldbearer: Spend terror to calm horror — the shield, not the sword. (Offered in the final beat.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "TONIGHT: The Talent Pit. Talent show, judged by beings who have never seen talent. Applause is measured in decibels and confusion."
📺 SYSTEM: "Tonight's spectacle is presented by the Meridian Court. Beauty is mandatory. Applause will be measured."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (23/15/8), with 5 wave-4 fought, 5 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 6 · Forage 63 → 24 · capped · Craft 16 · Talk 11 · Explore 55 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ Aurora Schmitz walks out of the light alone, which is how they walked in — and the galaxy, which came to watch a monster, leaves afraid of the right things. The fear is a shield now, held over a village that trusts the hand that holds it.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
